summary: Corcept reports positive trials and has resubmitted FDA-requested analyses. Whether these resolve the Cushing’s application’s prior questions remains unestablished; the separate oncology approval does not settle this indication.
pivotalQuestion: Do the additional analyses resolve FDA’s prior questions for Cushing’s syndrome, accounting for GRACE’s randomized-withdrawal population?

factors.rationale: Corcept reports positive trials, but endpoint-level results are not supplied. GRACE uses randomized withdrawal; the additional analyses have not been shown to resolve FDA’s prior questions.
No Cushing’s-specific safety findings are supplied.
No product-linked manufacturing, facility compliance, or CMC findings are supplied.
Corcept reports resubmission and a December 17 review target. Relacorilant’s separate oncology approval provides regulatory context, not approval for Cushing’s syndrome.
